verdict.rationale: Gitea is described first-party as a "free, self-hosted Git service under the MIT license" (gitea-docs-30). Its public source repository at github.com/go-gitea/gitea includes build-setup and development docs for working with the code (gitea-gh-1, gitea-gh-2). A community user's critique of internals such as go-macaron and logic in Go templates (gitea-comm-11) suggests outsiders do read the code. missing for 10: direct evidence of the LICENSE file in the repo, independent confirmation of the license terms.
